findings.current: And Go Jun had clearly been at death’s door.
findings.defect: The draft changes Go Jun from unequivocally dead to merely close to death, undermining the central resurrection mystery.
findings.rationale: 죽음을 맞이한 상태였다 states that he had already died, not that he was approaching death.
findings.replacement: And Go Jun had unquestionably been dead.

findings.current: Because my opponent was not a human being like me.
findings.defect: The draft omits the explicit conclusion that Go Jun is a monster, weakening Taekyung’s stated justification for feeling no pity.
findings.rationale: 괴물이니까 explicitly identifies him as a monster and supplies the causal reason for the preceding lack of pity.
findings.replacement: Because my opponent wasn’t human like me. He was a monster.
findings.source: 상대는 나와 같은 인간이 아니라 괴물이니까.

findings.current: The Disciple who had served Lee Jungryong faithfully for decades, and the de facto master of one of the most prominent Guilds in the world, had died by my hand.
findings.defect: The draft omits the established organization name Ares Guild, making Go Jun’s institutional identity less specific.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly names 아레스 길드 and describes it as one of the world’s foremost Guilds.
findings.replacement: The Disciple who had served Lee Jungryong faithfully for decades—and the de facto master of Ares Guild, one of the foremost Guilds in the world—had died by my hand.
findings.source: 지난 수십 년간 이정룡에게 충성을 바친 제자이자, 세계에서도 손꼽히는 아레스 길드의 실질적인 주인이 내 손에 죽었다.

findings.current: Why had the System window announcing his defeat still not appeared?
findings.defect: “Defeat” weakens the System mechanic from confirmation of a kill or elimination to a generic combat loss, even though Go Jun has already been defeated in battle.
findings.rationale: 처치 in this context is the System-confirmed elimination that would establish Go Jun’s death, which is why its absence reveals that he is alive.
findings.replacement: Why had the System window announcing his kill still not appeared?
findings.source: 왜 처치를 알리는 시스템 창은 아직까지도 뜨지 않을까.

findings.current: “Whether you’re going to heaven or hell, go there first and wait for me. When I get there, I’ll kill you to your heart’s content.”
findings.defect: “To your heart’s content” incorrectly makes Go Jun the one deriving satisfaction from the killing and produces an incoherent threat.
findings.rationale: 원 없이 죽여 줄 테니까 expresses Taekyung’s threat to kill Go Jun without restraint or lingering dissatisfaction, not Go Jun’s desire to be killed.
findings.replacement: “Whether you’re going to heaven or hell, go there first and wait for me. When I get there, I’ll kill you as much as I please.”
findings.source: “네가 가는 곳이 천국이든, 지옥이든. 먼저 가서 기다리고 있어라. 그때는 정말 원 없이 죽여 줄 테니까.”

findings.current: He had caused two Monster Waves on purpose, creating thousands of casualties and sacrificing Kim Hwajong and more than twenty members of the Peace Guild.
findings.defect: “More than twenty” turns the approximate quantity 이십여 명 into a strict lower bound.
findings.rationale: 이십여 명 means approximately twenty or twenty-odd people, while “more than twenty” specifically excludes twenty and lacks the source’s approximation.
findings.replacement: He had caused two Monster Waves on purpose, creating thousands of casualties and costing Kim Hwajong and some twenty members of the Peace Guild their lives.
findings.source: 두 번의 몬스터 웨이브를 인위적으로 일으켜 수천의 사상자를 발생시키고, 김화종과 이십여 명의 평화 길드원을 희생시킨 대가를 죽음으로 받아 냈다.

findings.current: But today, the place where I had kept that promise deep in my heart had collapsed.
findings.defect: The English syntax makes the physical place sound like the location inside his heart where he stored the promise, rather than the cherished place associated with that promise.
findings.rationale: 마음 깊은 곳에 간직하고 있던 modifies 약속, while 약속의 장소 is the real-world location that collapsed.
findings.replacement: But today, the place from the promise I had kept deep in my heart had collapsed.
findings.source: 하지만 오늘. 마음 깊은 곳에 간직하고 있던 약속의 장소가 무너졌다.

summary: The draft contains one critical death-state reversal and several meaningful omissions or shifts involving characterization, identity, System mechanics, quantity, and agency.
